notes: Proposed evolved URL Shortener architecture uses a load balancer in front of replicated application instances.
Proposed evolved Reverse Proxy architecture uses a load balancer to distribute connections across redundant proxy instances.
Case Study 7 develops a system-level design for the reusable Load Balancer component.
CDN architecture uses traffic distribution for origins and may use load balancing within delivery services.
File upload APIs use load balancing across replicated gateway and upload-service instances.
File download control-plane APIs use load balancing across replicated gateway and download-service instances.
URL Preview APIs use load balancing across replicated preview-service instances.
Link Preview Generator APIs use load balancing across replicated generator instances.
Webhook API and delivery-control traffic use load balancing across replicated platform instances.
HTTP proxy traffic and management APIs use load balancing across replicated proxy instances.
WhatsApp-style messaging clients and API traffic use load balancing across gateways and connection services.
